exits.label: 石板上的星图需要天文台

scenes.description: 考古系地下仓库的灯光忽明忽暗。一排编号木箱中有一个被撬开了——里面的南太平洋石雕和你们见过的石板纹路完全一致。箱子标签写着惠特利教授的名字和'待销毁'三个红字。系主任似乎想销毁证据。
scenes.image_prompt: university archaeology department basement storage, numbered crates, one pried open revealing Pacific stone carvings matching slab patterns, flickering lights, Ink Frenzy style, academic cover-up, institutional horror

scenes.description: 系主任办公室的保险柜没锁好。里面是惠特利教授的完整田野调查报告，记录了南太平洋遗迹的精确坐标和水下结构的异常声呐读数。报告结论被黑笔划掉重写：'建议销毁所有样本和记录——那东西知道我们碰了它'。一份星图拓片夹在报告里。
scenes.image_prompt: 1920s university archaeology office, open wall safe, field report on desk with blacked-out sections, sun-bleached excavation photograph in frame, Ink Frenzy style, sepia tones only, no bright colors, academic noir, balanced 16:9 widescreen composition, focal center, no empty areas, fully filled frame, avoid human figures, focus on environment and architecture
